remarks: LEGAL BASEMENT SUITE, 6 BEDROOMS & 4 BATHROOMS! Welcome to this single-family home offering space for the whole family and the added benefit of rental income potential. The main floor features an impressive open-to-above living area, creating an airy and inviting space to gather and entertain. A spice kitchen adds convenience for meal preparation, while a main floor bedroom and bathroom provide a comfortable option for guests or extended family. Upstairs, you'll find the primary bedroom with its own 5-piece ensuite, along with 2 additional bedrooms and another bathroom. The fully finished basement features a legal suite, ideal for multigenerational living or as a potential mortgage helper. Ideally located just minutes from schools, parks, shopping, and everyday amenities. (id:67522)
